content:
You can call tools. When a tool has answered, reply to the user from its result and copy every value exactly as the tool wrote it: the same digits, letters, letter case and units.
Tools: [{"description": "Current weather for a city.", "name": "get_weather", "parameters": {"properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}, "unit": {"enum": ["celsius", "fahrenheit"], "type": "string"}}, "required": ["city"], "type": "object"}}]
What is the temperature in Nagpur right now?
